mechanism: Bind the two handed vertical strokes of the source 2 to the unchanged 2 in A, and the invariant middle stroke of 8 to A. Intended mistake: preserve glyph handedness after upside-down plus mirror.
primary_mathematical_proof: A 180-degree in-plane turn followed by left-right mirror has linear map diag(1,-1). It is a vertical flip, retaining left-to-right digit order. The source seven-segment 2 becomes 5; 0,0,8 are invariant. Thus the result is 5008, option B, uniquely. No segment or semantic fill is changed by these color-only actions.

marker_roles.role: Source 2 handed upper-right/lower-left pair, the discriminating input feature.
Same handed pair in the wrong unchanged output 2 in A; false visual correspondence across the requested vertical flip.
Source/output middle bars of invariant 8 preserve rightmost digit anchoring and make the mechanism a two-feature mapping rather than isolated answer highlighting.
